result:
QA-21874 is a **PASS** on Wednesday's first row (Apple Services / Apple Music). Four of five channels matched, and LinkedIn couldn't be tested.

Engagements / Total Followers × 100 matched the first post's Response Rate on each channel that has data:

| Channel | Calculated | UI Response Rate |
|---|---|---|
| Facebook | 0.2422% | 0.24% |
| Instagram | 9.7694% | 9.77% |
| Twitter | 0.2748% | 0.27% |
| TikTok | 6.0501% | 6.05% |

- **LinkedIn:** it is N/A. Apple Music has no LinkedIn data, so Content shows 0 posts and the channel is disabled on Insights.
- **Instagram Rank 2:** this post doesn't match at 2 decimals. 283,288 / 5,856,736 gives 4.84% against the UI's 4.85%. The spec only asserts on the first post, so the verdict is unchanged. I noted it in the report as the same follower-snapshot pattern as the HBO Max failure on 2026-10-26.
- **Scope:** I ran only the first Wednesday row. NBCU Enterprises with CNBC and NBC News was not run, same as earlier runs.
- **Case notes conflict:** the case Notes map Wednesday to "Apple Services/Wasserman", but the Description table lists NBCU Enterprises. I followed the table.

I didn't visually inspect the screenshots, since every value came from the DOM. No bugs were filed.

The report is at `results/2026-10-28/QA-21874-report.md`.
